title: Book class with loan status
statement: Define a Book class with a parameterless constructor that starts unborrowed, a Borrow method, a GiveBack method, and an IsBorrowed method that returns 1 if it is borrowed or 0 if not. Read two flags (1 or 0): whether to borrow the book, and whether to give it back afterwards. Create the object, apply those two actions in order and write the result of IsBorrowed.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.
